ordering-key.why: The subscription sets enable_message_ordering = true, and the publisher client enables message ordering and publishes with ordering_key=o["customer_id"].

dedup.why: The Terraform comment and the summary's behavior table both flag that content-based dedup has no equivalent and the worker must be idempotent.

dlq-5.why: The subscription has dead_letter_policy with max_delivery_attempts = 5, and the Pub/Sub agent gets publisher on the DLQ topic and subscriber on the orders subscription.

ack-deadline.why: ack_deadline_seconds = 360, which is within the 600 s limit.

concurrency.why: The api service sets max_instance_request_concurrency = 1, max_instance_count = 20 and min_instance_count = 1.

auth-private.why: There is no allUsers binding; run.invoker goes only to the scheduler service account (api) and the push service account (worker).

signed-url.why: The code uses generate_signed_url(version="v4", method="PUT", expiration=3600 s) with service_account_email and access_token, and Terraform grants serviceAccountTokenCreator on the api service account to itself.

cloudsql-iam.why: Cloud SQL is POSTGRES_15 with cloudsql.iam_authentication=on, availability_type REGIONAL, PITR enabled and retained_backups = 7.

worker-event-shape.why: worker.py reads the push body message.data as base64, handles one message per call, and returns 500 on error instead of batchItemFailures.

sql-dialect.why: The SQL uses SAFE_CAST, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT, ARRAY_AGG(... IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY ... LIMIT 3), UNNEST(o.items) AS i, and FORMAT_DATE/DATE_SUB, keeping the string dt filter.

scheduler-tz.why: Cloud Scheduler uses schedule = "0 2 * * *" with time_zone = "America/New_York".

lifecycle.why: The bucket has SetStorageClass NEARLINE at age 30, Delete at 365, versioning enabled, public_access_prevention enforced and uniform_bucket_level_access.

region.why: The bucket and dataset use a single region, upper(us-east4), and the summary notes the region change.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the changed retry/backoff, concurrency, scaling mapping, batch semantics, added IAM, public IP, soft delete and deletion_protection, and keeps the 300 s and 60 s timeouts.
